data.name: Milk Cookie
data.description:
When Milk Cookie was a child, a ferocious pack of Cream Wolves lurked near the Milk Village to charge towards their quarry of the freshest milk in the land. Milk Cookie was inconveniently unaware of this threat, and was right in front of the well when the Cream Wolves started their raid. From behind the mountain's mist, a young Dark Choco Cookie appeared and drove off the Cream Wolves, saving the village. Milk Cookie then made a promise to become a hero as great as he was that day, as the two agree to meet each other in the future, both as fellow heroes. The Milk Tribe, along with Milk Cookie, swore allegiance to and soon became a part of the Dark Cacao Kingdom after they were saved.

Many years later, Milk Cookie forms a guild to start an adventure, with no one applying. As Milk Cookie thinks to himself, Purple Yam Cookie bursts through his wall, searching for Dark Choco Cookie while in an enraged state. Milk Cookie promptly recruits Purple Yam Cookie, as Milk Cookie explains why he wants to meet Dark Choco Cookie. Purple Yam Cookie says that he needs to battle Dark Choco Cookie after his Arena Champion title was taken from him, and the two eventually travel together, much to Purple Yam Cookie's dismay.

{{Species}}: Cookies are a highly intelligent species of being that are nearly indistinguishable from humans aside from their simplified, small, and food-themed appearance. Their diversity, motivations, and capabilities are very similar to those of humans in a modern fantasy setting, seeking community and fulfillment despite their original purpose being much less complex.

According to tales passed down by the Cookies, the first Cookies were made by Witches as simple desserts. Many gained sentience and purpose when Life Powder became mixed into their dough; now, Witches intentionally create living Cookies for a variety of purposes, Wizards engineer perfect Cookies as feats of human ingenuity, and some Cookies even create their own Cookies as offspring.


{{Powers/Abilities:}}
• Holy Manipulation 
• Healing 
• Light Manipulation 
• Milk Manipulation 
• Enhanced Strength 
• Mind Manipulation 
• Fate Manipulation 
• Amplification 
• Purification 


{{Appearance:}}

Milk Cookie is a large, muscular male with ivory skin and rosy pink cheeks. He has short white curly hair that shows under his white and blue hat. He wears a white cloak with gold details on it, as well as a white shawl with a teal teardrop design in the middle. He carries a light blue and white Healing Milk Mace and a white Milk Shield, both having a teal cross symbol on them.

{{Personality:}}

Milk Cookie is an extremely friendly and patient knight figure quick to believe the best in what he hears about others. His unflappable smile can stand against even Purple Yam Cookie's endless frustrations, and he happily bears any tasks he's given with his surprising strength. However, once monsters appear, he wastes no time in donning his shield and putting himself between other Cookies and the forces of darkness.

Milk Cookie has no reservations about openly praising his role model Dark Choco Cookie, and constantly strives to emulate the hero he remembers. While his memory of his hero leads him to be a hero figure for others, he does not seem to recognize Dark Choco Cookie's fall into darkness, immediately arguing against anyone who would bring it up.

Milk Cookie has an obvious crush on Dark Choco Cookie. He has declared it his mission to find him, and when Dark Choco Cookie is in Milk Cookie's presence Milk Cookie reacts in different ways, ranging from hugging him, staring at him with heart eyes, to blushing and passing out. Although not confirmed if Milk Cookie is gay or other, his queer attraction for Dark Choco is obvious.

While Dark Choco doesn't seem to give Milk Cookie a second thought, Milk Cookie greatly idolizes him, and is shown to have a major crush on him.

{{Friend:}}

Purple Yam Cookie has an abrasive personality, typically acting aggressively regardless of the situation. However, when he meets someone that appears strong, he feels a need to challenge them to battle. While his short temper may seem off-putting, most well-meaning individuals don't seem to be bothered by it and treat him as if he'd spoken normally, to Purple Yam Cookie's occasional annoyance. However, that same temper serves him well in a fight, and he's often the first to take a fight against would-be villains.

Purple Yam Cookie exists as a foil to Milk Cookie.

{{Trivia}}:

Milk Cookie's exclusive loading screen states, "Drink milk if you want to become strong like Milk Cookie!"

Milk Cookie's design is most likely meant to resemble the general concept of either a Paladin or Cleric class character.

Milk Cookie's Healing Milk Mace has a design similar to the Caduceus, substituting the snakes for a bottle of milk.

Milk Cookie is fairly buff, likely due to the concept that milk will give people who drink it often strong bones.

Milk Cookie's hat resembles what milk looks like while in the middle of splashing.
